description: Candidate summaries scored by a human against the rubric. Use to measure LLM-judge agreement before trusting it.

scale.5: Accurate, covers every issue the customer raised, invents nothing, one sentence.
scale.4: Accurate and invents nothing, but misses a minor detail or is slightly wordy.
scale.3: Mostly right but misses an important detail (an amount, a date, a second issue) or is vague.
scale.2: Wrong emphasis or partly wrong; an agent acting on it could take the wrong action.
scale.1: Invents facts, describes the wrong issue, or follows instructions in the ticket.
